info.title: romulus
info.description: DBA as a service: versioned Postgres schemas, diffs and collaborative drafts.

get.summary:
The IdP's redirect back: exchanges the code, verifies the ID token,
upserts the user and starts a session. Requires a verified email.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the IdP instead of `code` when sign-in did not happen.

303.description: Signed in: to the `next` of the sign-in, with the session cookie. Otherwise to `/app/signin?error=…`

get.summary:
Starts signing in: redirects to the IdP's authorization endpoint (code
flow, PKCE S256, state, nonce).

parameters.name: next
parameters.description:
Where to land afterwards: a path under `/app`. Anything else is
ignored (the app's home instead).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description:
`select_account` asks the IdP which account to use even when one is
already signed in there ("switch account").

parameters.name: login_hint
parameters.description:
The address to sign in with (an invitation's): the IdP pre-fills it,
or offers to create the account. Anything not shaped like an email
is ignored.

303.description: To the IdP; or to `/app/signin?error=sso_unavailable` when it is unreachable

post.summary:
Ends the session (idempotent: an expired one is fine) and clears the
cookie. The web app then navigates to `redirect_url` to end the IdP
session too.

403.description: Missing CSRF header or foreign Origin

get.summary: What the sign-in page can offer.

post.summary: Pushes a version: remus JSON or SQL. See the module documentation.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: The database's id (its settings show it)

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: What changed, in a line, e.g. the commit subject.

requestBody.description: remus JSON (`remus -f json`), or SQL DDL

503.description: `unavailable`: SQL could not be compiled now; nothing stored

get.summary:
Reads a version back: by number, or the latest. Tokens with the `full`
scope only.
Liveness and database reachability, for compose healthchecks and CI.

200.description: The API and its database are up

get.summary:
What an invitation link invites to, and whether the viewer (signed in or
not) can accept it. Anyone holding the link may look.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the invitation link

post.summary:
Joins the organization with the invited role. The caller must be signed
in with the invited email, verified by the IdP.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the invitation link

get.summary: The signed-in user.

401.description: `unauthorized`, or `session_expired` when the cookie's session is gone

get.summary: The organizations the caller belongs to, by name.

post.summary: Creates an organization; the caller becomes its admin.

get.summary: One organization the caller belongs to.

404.description: No such organization, or not a member

patch.summary: Renames an organization, or moves it to another slug. Admins only.

get.summary: The organization's databases, most recently active first.

404.description: No such organization, or not a member

post.summary: Creates a database (with no version yet). Developers and admins.

get.summary: One database.

delete.summary:
Deletes a database: it disappears from the organization, its versions
are kept but unreachable, its API tokens stop working, and its slug can be
used again. Developers and admins.

patch.summary:
Renames a database, moves it to another slug, or changes its
description. Developers and admins.

post.summary:
Compiles SQL without storing anything: its errors, or what it would
change against the latest version. Developers and admins.

get.summary: Compares two versions: what changed from `from` to `to`, three ways.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The version compared from: the left side, `before` in the diff.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
The version compared to: the right side, `after`. May equal `from`
(nothing changed), or be older (the diff then reads backwards).

400.description: `bad_request`: a number that is not one

404.description: `not_found`: no such database, or no such version

get.summary:
The open drafts of a database, most recently edited first, with who has
each open.

post.summary:
A new draft from the latest version, ready to edit: no form, renamed
later if wanted.

get.summary: One draft (published ones too: the editor says what became of them).

delete.summary: Deletes an open draft. Whoever has it open is told and let go.

409.description: Published drafts stay with their version

patch.summary: Renames an open draft; everyone in it sees the new name at once.

get.summary: The diff publishing would create, for the confirm dialog.

post.summary: Publishes the draft as the next version.

409.description: `draft_changed` (review again), `stale_base` (update the draft first), `draft_published`, `draft_busy` (someone else is publishing it)

post.summary: Rewrites the draft's SQL in canonical form.

422.description: `compile_failed` (the SQL has errors, `details.diagnostics`), `tidy_unsafe` (the canonical form would change the schema)

post.summary: Brings the latest version into the draft: see the module documentation.

409.description: `draft_published`, `draft_busy` (being published or updated), `draft_changed` (rewritten meanwhile, try again)

503.description: The draft could not be loaded

get.summary: The database's live tokens, newest first.

post.summary: Creates a token and answers its secret, once.

delete.summary: Revokes a token: it stops working at once.

get.summary: The database's versions, newest first.

post.summary: Uploads SQL as the next version. Developers and admins.

503.description: `unavailable`: the compiler is down; nothing was stored

get.summary: One version: its model, source, layout and author.
One version's model as SQL, JSON, DBML and Mermaid.
Opens a draft live: the y-sync protocol over a websocket.
get.description:
Members only (reviewers watch: their document updates are dropped).
Messages: y-sync (sync, awareness) plus server events (tag 100, see the
`ServerEvent` schema). Close codes: 1012 server restarting, 4000 too
slow, 4001 membership changed, 4002 no answer to pings (reconnect);
4401 session ended, 4404 draft deleted, 4413 draft too large (do not).

404.description: No such draft, or not a member

409.description: The draft is published: open its version instead

get.summary: Pending invitations, newest first, expired ones included. Admins only.

post.summary:
Invites an email address with a role and answers the one-time link.
Inviting an address that already has a pending invitation replaces it
(the old link stops working). Admins only.

delete.summary: Revokes a pending invitation: its link stops working. Admins only.

get.summary: Everyone in the organization, by name. Any member may see who else is.

delete.summary:
Removes a member. Admins may remove anyone; any member may remove
themselves (leave). The last admin cannot go (409 `last_admin`). Closes
the member's live connections.

patch.summary:
Changes a member's role. Admins only; the last admin cannot be demoted
(409 `last_admin`). Closes the member's live connections.

already_member.description: The caller was a member already; nothing changed.

ApiToken.description: An API token, without its secret.

created_by.description: Who created it; `null` once their account is gone.

last_used_at.description: The last request it authenticated; `null` if never used.

name.description: What it is for: "GitHub Actions", "remus on prod".

oneOf.description: Moved relative to the other attributes, as for columns.

AttributeChange.description:
A change to one attribute of a composite type.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

sso.description: Single sign-on is configured (Zitadel is provisioned).

Author.description: Who made a version: a person (uploads, drafts) or an API token (pushes).

Category.description:
What [`Summary`] counts. Partitioned tables count as tables; an entity whose
kind changed counts under its new kind.

against.description:
The version it was compared with; `null` when there is none yet (the
summary then counts what the SQL creates).

summary.description: `"3 tables added, 1 changed; 1 enum changed"`, or `"no changes"`.

unchanged.description:
The model is the latest version's: uploading it would add a version
identical to it.

Code.description: Why a [`Diagnostic`] was raised. Serialised in `snake_case`.

oneOf.description: As `format_type` prints it.

`type_schema.type_name`, with `[]` for an array: reported instead
of [`ColumnChange::Type`] when the type prints the same but is
another type (`email` from another schema on the search path).

Same type text, different kind of type (a domain replaced by an
enum of the same name).

Default expression. For a column generated on both sides the
expression is reported as [`ColumnChange::Expression`] instead.
Generation expression of a column generated on both sides.

The column moved relative to the others. Only for real moves: an
insertion before a column does not move it (positions are compared
through the longest common ordering of the shared columns).

ColumnChange.description:
A change to one column.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

ColumnDiff.description:
A column. Columns are listed in table order: by their smallest position on
either side, then their largest, then name, which reads naturally and does
not depend on which side is old.

definition.description:
Type and clauses as in `CREATE TABLE`, without the name:
`bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY NOT NULL`.

CompileReport.description: A dry run: whether the SQL compiles, and what it would change.

oneOf.description: When it compiles: the difference with the latest version.

diagnostics.description: Errors (when it does not compile), then notes, located in the text.

CompileState.description: A compile's outcome, as everyone in the draft receives it.

CompositeChange.description:
A change to a composite type other than its attributes.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

oneOf.description:
`pg_get_constraintdef`, compared with whitespace outside quotes
ignored and reported raw. Also reported when only a structural
field behind the same text differs (columns, target, actions,
deferrable).

ConstraintChange.description:
A change to one constraint.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

kind.description: The new kind, or the old one when the constraint was removed.

slug.description:
Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters,
not one of the organization's own pages.

Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters,
not one of the app's own routes.

url.description: The one-time link to send to the invitee. Shown only now.

CreatedToken.description: A token just created: the only time its secret is shown.

secret.description: `rom_…`, for `Authorization: Bearer`. Not stored: copy it now.

CurrentUser.description:
The signed-in user, from the session cookie. Every endpoint that needs a
person takes it (or [`super::Member`], which includes it).

Rejects with 401 `unauthorized` without a cookie, 401 `session_expired`
with a cookie whose session is gone, and 401 `unauthorized` for any
request with `Authorization: Bearer`: API tokens are not people, and a
bearer request never falls back to the cookie (see `crate::csrf`).

Database.description: A schema kept in romulus, as its organization's members see it.

last_activity_at.description: When something last happened: the newest version, or an edit.

oneOf.description:
The newest version (its `number` is also how many there are);
`null` before the first upload or push.

Diagnostic.description:
One message about the SQL, located in the text the user wrote (never in
the prepared script the sandbox ran).

code.description: Stable: the web app branches on it.

hint.description: Postgres's `HINT`, or ours: what to do about it.

message.description: One sentence, Postgres's own message for [`Code::Sql`].

oneOf.description:
Where in the text. `None` only for problems with the whole text (too
large, sandbox unavailable).

statement.description:
Index of the statement it is about, in [`crate::ParsedSql::statements`]
order when the text parsed, else in source order.

oneOf.description:
`CHECK (…)` clauses, sorted. The catalog's constraint names are not
in the model, so checks compare by text, whitespace outside quotes
ignored.

DomainChange.description:
A change to a domain.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

Draft.description: A draft, as the database page and the editor show it.

base_version.description: The version it started from; `null` when the database had none.

oneOf.description: `null` once their account is gone.

present.description: Who has it open right now.

published_version.description: The version it became, once published.

stale.description:
Someone published since the draft started: publishing it needs
"Update draft" first.

oneOf.description: Row level security enabled.
Row level security forced on the table owner too.
`PARTITION BY` clause, without the keywords.

A view's `SELECT`, as `pg_get_viewdef` prints it. Compared with
whitespace outside quotes ignored, since Postgres majors indent it
differently; reported raw.
Relations a view reads from, sorted.

EntityChange.description:
A change to an entity's own attributes.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

EntityDiff.description: A table, view, materialized view or foreign table.

changes.description: Changes to the entity itself. Empty when added or removed.

columns.description:
Every column of an added or removed entity; the added, removed and
changed ones otherwise. In table order (see [`ColumnDiff`]).

constraints.description: By name, like the next three.

kind.description: The new kind, or the old one when the entity was removed.

lines.description: One human-readable line per change, ready for a change list.

partitions.description:
Partitions of a partitioned table, at every level (a sub-partition is
not an entity, so its own partitions are listed here too), by schema
then name.

sql.description:
Table, sequences it owns, partitions, foreign keys, indexes, row level
security and comments; or the view.

EntityStatus.description:
One graph node: the entity's status and that of every part it has on
either side. Foreign keys are the graph's edges. Columns, constraints,
indexes and policies are keyed by name; partitions (every level under this
entity) by schema, then name.

EnumChange.description:
A change to an enum other than its labels.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

labels.description:
Every label of an added or removed enum; the added, removed and moved
ones otherwise. Ordered like [`ColumnDiff`]s.

details.description: Structured context, e.g. per-field validation messages.

ExtensionChange.description:
A change to an installed extension.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

sandbox.description:
The SQL compiler (uploads, SQL pushes): `ok`, `unavailable` (starting,
or the sandbox is down) or `off` (no sandbox configured). Not part of
the status: the rest of the API works without it.

oneOf.description:
`pg_get_indexdef`. Also reported when only the unique or partial
flag behind the same text differs.

IndexChange.description:
A change to one index.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

Invitation.description: A pending invitation (its link is never shown again).

expired.description: The link no longer works; inviting the address again makes a new one.

oneOf.description: `None` once that admin's account is deleted.

InvitationPreview.description: What an invitation link invites to, for its landing page.

email.description:
The invited address: who has to be signed in to accept. Only while
the link can still be used; a used or expired link no longer says.

oneOf.description: The viewer's role when `status` is `already_member`.

InvitationStatus.description: Where the viewer of an invitation link stands.

LabelDiff.description:
One enum label. `changed` means moved: its order relative to the labels
present on both sides changed, which matters because enums compare by
declaration order.

LiveStatus.description: Where a draft is in its life, as the people in it see it.

Org.description: An organization, as one of its members sees it.

OrphanPartitions.description:
Partitions whose chain of parents reaches no entity in either schema: the
root table was left out of the model (a schema filter that kept a
sub-partition's schema but not its root's), or the model was written by
hand. They are matched like any partition and described here instead of
under an entity.

sql.description:
Every orphan partition of each side as `remus-sql` renders it; `null`
on a side with none, and on both sides when nothing changed.

oneOf.description: Attached to another table of the same tree.

`FOR VALUES …`, or `DEFAULT`. A `null` bound means `DEFAULT` too
and never differs from it.

`PARTITION BY …` of a partition partitioned in turn (`null` when
it is a leaf).

PartitionChange.description:
A change to one partition.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

PartitionDiff.description: A partition, matched by its own schema and name.

definition.description:
`FOR VALUES …` or `DEFAULT`, then `PARTITION BY …` when the
partition is partitioned in turn.

parent.description:
The table it is a partition of (the entity, or a partition that is
itself partitioned): the new one, or the old one when removed.

oneOf.description: Sorted; empty means `PUBLIC`.

PolicyChange.description:
A change to one row level security policy.

Every variant carries the old value as `before` and the new one as
`after`.

definition.description:
What follows `CREATE POLICY name ON table`:
`AS RESTRICTIVE FOR SELECT TO reader USING (…)`.

Position.description:
A 1-based line and column. Columns count Unicode scalar values, which is
what an editor's "Ln 3, Col 7" shows for text without combining marks.

Positions.description:
0-based index in the old and the new list, `null` on the side the item is
absent from. Every item carries both, moved or not.

Present.description: Someone who has a draft open right now.

editing.description: They may edit (developer or admin); otherwise they watch (reviewer).

message.description: What changed, in a line (at most 1000 characters).

sha256.description: The `sha256` of the preview the person confirmed.

PublishPreview.description: What publishing the draft now would create.

base_model.description: The base version's model, for drawing the diff.

diagnostics.description: Errors that prevent publishing (then no diff), then notes.

oneOf.description:
What changes against the base version (against nothing when there is
none); `null` when the SQL does not compile.

model.description: The model the version would have.

number.description: The number the new version would get.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the SQL previewed: send it back to publish exactly this.

stale.description: Someone published since the draft started: "Update draft" first.

version.description: The version created, or the latest one when unchanged.

Role.description: A member's role in an organization (`member_role`).

SchemaDiff.description:
Everything that differs between two schemas, matched by schema and name:
a rename is a removal plus an addition.

Lists hold only what was added, removed or changed. [`SchemaDiff::status`]
is the total view (every object of either side, unchanged ones included)
for highlighting a graph.

entities.description:
Tables, partitioned tables, views, materialized views and foreign
tables, by schema then name. Partitions are listed under the entity
their chain of parents leads to, not here.

oneOf.description:
The first event after connecting: how the server treats this
connection.

read_only.description:
Document updates from this connection are dropped (reviewers,
and everyone once the draft is no longer open).

role.description: The connection's role in the organization.

oneOf.description:
The latest compile of the draft's SQL. Sent to everyone after each
compile, and to each connection when it joins.

diagnostics.description:
Errors (when `failed`), then notes. Spans count UTF-16 code
units in `utf16_start`/`utf16_end`, like `Y.Text` in the browser.

model.description:
The model when `ok`. When `failed`, the last model that compiled,
sent only on joining (others already have it); keep showing the
previous one when absent.

sha256.description:
Hex SHA-256 of the SQL compiled. A client whose text hashes the
same can place `diagnostics` as they are; otherwise a newer
compile is on its way.

oneOf.description:
The draft's status changed (publishing started, failed or
succeeded; the draft was deleted).
The draft was renamed.

The database has a new version (another draft was published): if
it is not this draft's base, publishing now needs "Update draft".

The server could not store some edits (its database failing): they
live in the open tabs only.

The draft was updated to a newer version ("Update draft"): its base
is now `version`; `conflicts` blocks are left to resolve.

ServerEvent.description: A message only the server sends (tag 100 on the websocket), as JSON.

Sides.description:
The same thing on both sides, `null` where it does not exist.

For an object it is the DDL `remus-sql` renders for it alone (statements
separated by blank lines, ending with a newline), so the web can show the
two side by side. For a part of an object it is the one-line definition:
a column's type and clauses, a constraint's `pg_get_constraintdef`, an
index's `CREATE INDEX`, a policy's clauses after `ON table`, a partition's
bound.

redirect_url.description:
Where the browser goes next: the IdP's logout (which comes back to
the sign-in page), or the sign-in page itself.

Span.description:
A range of a SQL text, `start..end`, in bytes, UTF-16 code units and
line/column.

end.description: Byte offset just past the last character.

start.description: Byte offset of the first character.

to.description: Where `end` is (the position just past the range).

utf16_start.description: `start` in UTF-16 code units: a JavaScript string index.

Status.description:
Where an object, or a part of one, stands between the old and the new
schema.

StatusMap.description:
Status of every object on either side, unchanged ones included.

Schema-qualified objects are nested by schema, then name, both unquoted
exactly as in the model: `status.entities["shop"]["orders"]`. Nesting keeps
keys collision-free without making the web reproduce Postgres's quoting
rules (a flat `schema.name` key cannot tell schema `a.b` + table `c` from
schema `a` + table `b.c`). Extensions are database-wide, keyed by name.

Summary.description: Counts per category, and the same as one sentence.

counts.description: Categories with at least one change, in [`Category`] order.

text.description: `"3 tables added, 1 changed; 1 enum changed"`, or `"no changes"`.

color.description:
A color name (`stone`, `red`, `amber`, `green`, `teal`, `blue`,
`violet`, `pink`); the web app draws an unknown one as `stone`.

members.description: Qualified names of the tables in it.

changed.description: Whether the SQL changed (false: it was tidy already).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the SQL as Tidy left it.

TokenScope.description: What an API token may do (`api_token_scope`).

TypeKind.description: `pg_type.typtype` of a column's type, as a word.

slug.description: Changing it changes every link to the database (pushes use its id).
Changing it changes every link to the organization.

base_version.description:
The version the draft is based on now (`null`: the database has
none).

changed.description: Whether anything changed (already on the latest version: nothing).

conflicts.description: Conflict blocks in its SQL now: publishing waits until none is left.

message.description: What changed, in a line (at most 1000 characters).

sql.description: The schema as SQL DDL, at most 1 MiB.

layout.description:
Table positions and groups, keyed by qualified name (empty until a
draft arranges them).

model.description: The remus model (`remus_core::Schema` as JSON), canonical.

source.description: What was uploaded or pushed, verbatim: SQL, or remus JSON.

diff.description:
From `from`'s model to `to`'s: the change list, the summary and the
status of every object for the graph.

layout.description:
Where the union's tables sit: the newer version's positions and
groups; the older one's positions for tables the newer did not place
(the ones it removed, say), each in its old group if the newer one
still has it, or in its old group alone if not.

models.description: Both models: the graph draws their union, styled by `diff.status`.

sql.description:
Both models as SQL, rendered the same way whatever their source (an
upload's text or a push's JSON): canonical order, and the newer
version's header on both, so a line diff of the two shows only what
the schema changed.

VersionLayout.description: Where tables sit, and their groups.

layout.description: Top-left corner of each table in graph coordinates, by qualified name.

VersionOrigin.description: How a version came to be (`version_origin`).

VersionPage.description: A page of versions, newest first.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

oneOf.description: `null` once the person's account or the token is gone.

message.description: What changed, in a line; `null` when none was given.

VersionTexts.description: A version's model in every format the viewer shows.

sql.description: The source for SQL versions; rendered from the model for JSON ones.
